blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Two soldiers who were wounded in a recent clash with a lawless armed group in Sultan Kudarat province were honored for courageously performing their duties. Brig. Gen. Ricky Bunayog, commander of the Army’s 6th Infantry Division and Joint Task Force Central, awarded the Wounded Personnel Medals to Sgt. George Tusan and Cpl. Gexter
